observation_default_hfov_deg.source: DEFAULT:authoring (FL-4809 OBSERVE-01: repo perspective-frame fallback 60 deg per register_observations.py and lower_plan_custom.py; no measured intrinsics basis)

rule: importance: landmark when a normalized feature name (triage label or IR name/name:en) equals a normalized required_landmarks entry (landmark_id, name, source_ref, lobe id); else route_visible when the feature point is within 30 m of the Valhalla pedestrian route polyline; else background. candidates: camera within 45 m of the feature point AND |wrap(bearing - heading)| <= hfov/2, ranked by (distance_m, |residual|, frame_id), line of sight required against every building_footprint ring except a ring containing the feature point (own parent) or the camera; keep the best 3. hfov: measured horizontal_fov_deg, else 2*atan(18/focal_35mm), else the observation_default_hfov_deg DEFAULT fact. observation_state: observed_boxed when a registered instance (custom_identity_subject match or shared capture_id with a kept frame) or a facade view (capture_id shared with a kept frame) references the feature; else frame_available_unboxed when kept frames exist; else observation_owed.
